TENDER SPECIFICATION — PUBLIC WORKS CONTRACT 2024

1. MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
   1.1 The supplier must hold ISO 9001:2015 certification.
   1.2 All works must comply with local building regulations.
   1.3 Contractor must provide a performance bond of 10% contract value.

2. RATED CRITERIA
   2.1 Previous experience with government contracts (weighted 30%).
   2.2 Proposed methodology and project timeline (weighted 40%).
   2.3 Environmental sustainability plan (weighted 30%).

3. INFORMATION ONLY
   3.1 Site visits will be conducted on request.
   3.2 Questions must be submitted no later than 14 days before closing date.
